title: Lithuanian customs suspends BAP authentication portal after unauthorised access
date_note: Detection date per ZATAZ (page last updated 18 Nov); the article gives no separate publication date.
summary: ZATAZ reports that Lithuanian customs detected an attack on 10 November and suspended its BAP portal, which authenticates users of customs services; some functions were restored through the e-government portal. The article says investigations confirmed unauthorised access, that several hundred people and companies may be affected, and that whether data was stolen is still open. No attacker is identified.
plain: Lithuania's customs authority shut down a login portal after an intrusion. Several hundred users may be affected, and it is not yet clear whether any data was stolen.
exec: An intrusion at a national customs authority disrupted authentication for customs services; data theft is not established.
action: Lithuanian customs users: use the alternative login routes the authority offers and watch for phishing that cites the incident.

validation.note: ZATAZ only; names no primary Lithuanian customs statement, which was not read.
